宇宙无尽的谜团最终都能被我们所掌控吗？
texts.en:
We have now begun the massive undertaking of constructing a Science Nexus. The foundation is in place and preparations are underway to add the main hub. The promise of new groundbreaking technologies and the realization of ideas beyond our wildest imaginations await. And though the road ahead is long and full of challenges, we have taken the first step.

Could the endless mysteries of the universe finally be within our grasp?
